verse.verse_1: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another
verse.verse_3: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;
verse.verse_4: By those who winnow with a winnowing,
verse.verse_5: By those who bring down the Reminder,
verse.verse_7: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.
verse.verse_8: So when the stars are put out,
verse.verse_9: And when the sky is riven asunder,
verse.verse_10: And when the mountains are blown away,
verse.verse_11: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -
verse.verse_12: For what day is the time appointed?
verse.verse_14: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -
verse.verse_15: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verse.verse_16: Destroyed We not the former folk,
verse.verse_17: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?
verse.verse_18: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.
verse.verse_19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verse.verse_20: Did We not create you from a base fluid
verse.verse_21: Which We laid up in a safe abode
verse.verse_23: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!
verse.verse_24: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verse.verse_25: Have We not made the earth a receptacle
verse.verse_26: Both for the living and the dead,
verse.verse_27: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?
verse.verse_28: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verse.verse_29: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;
verse.verse_30: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,
verse.verse_31: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.
verse.verse_32: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,
verse.verse_33: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.
verse.verse_34: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verse.verse_35: This is a day wherein they speak not,
verse.verse_36: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.
verse.verse_37: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verse.verse_38: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.
verse.verse_39: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.
verse.verse_40: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verse.verse_41: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,
verse.verse_42: And fruits such as they desire.
verse.verse_43: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.
verse.verse_44: Thus do We reward the good.
verse.verse_45: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verse.verse_46: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.
verse.verse_47: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verse.verse_48: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!
verse.verse_49: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
verse.verse_50: In what statement, after this, will they believe?
